page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance belonging to the ecs.c6t family. Built on x86_64 architecture and managed by a KVM hypervisor, this host features 104 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz.

The system configuration includes 192.0 GB of memory, resulting in a density of approximately 1.85 GB per vCPU. No local storage drives are included with the instance, requiring all persistent storage to be attached via cloud network volumes. Network connectivity is backed by a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth allocation. The server comes without discrete GPUs and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The 1:1.85 memory-to-vCPU ratio establishes this instance primarily for compute-bound tasks rather than memory-heavy database workloads. The absence of local NVMe storage relies on network storage performance for I/O execution. This instance structure provides resource efficiency for highly parallelized operations, batch processing, continuous integration build servers, and high-throughput web serving environments.
